:::{#exm-estimated-overall-agreement}
#### Estimated overall agreement for the COVID-19 test

For the [agreement table](#def-agreement-table) of @exm-agreement-table-covid,
the [estimated overall agreement](#def-estimated-overall-agreement) is:

$$
\ba
\Est{p}_o
&= \frac{693 + 9{,}207}{10{,}000}
&& \text{(definition of } \Est{p}_o \text{, with the table's counts)} \\
&= \frac{9{,}900}{10{,}000}
&& \text{(add)} \\
&= 0.99
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-exm-estimated-overall-agreement}

This [estimate](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) equals the [overall agreement](#def-overall-agreement) $p_o = 0.99$ of @exm-overall-agreement,
because the table's cell [counts](data.qmd#def-count) equal their expected counts.

:::
